title: Measuring the dynamic balance of integration and segregation underlying consciousness, anesthesia, and sleep in humans
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Predict behaviorally assessed awake versus loss-of-responsiveness states for the complete original Figure 5b,c Dataset-1 leave-one-subject-out result. This is an explicitly scoped paper result; transition-only and cross-dataset panels are separate original results and need not all be surpassed to claim this scope.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Predict behaviorally assessed awake versus loss-of-responsiveness states for the complete original Figure 5b,c Dataset-1 leave-one-subject-out result. This is an explicitly scoped paper result; transition-only and cross-dataset panels are separate original results and need not all be surpassed to claim this scope.

Source-paper comparison for Figure 5b,c complete Dataset-1 leave-one-subject-out awake/LOR balanced accuracy across all 19 subjects, with ROC AUC and required source controls retained: Balanced accuracy = (sensitivity + specificity)/2, higher is better; ROC AUC remains a separate reported endpoint. Static ISD and state-contrast significance are not classification accuracy.
success_criteria: Before candidate outcomes are examined, bind the complete original Figure 5b,c Dataset-1 LOSO panel as the claimed scope, including all 19 subjects, source state/window definitions, required original controls and companion ROC AUC. Report exactly which source result is surpassed.

Recover and reproduce the original state-label/time mapping, feature definitions, LOSO and sample-selection protocol and author random forest. Historical draws may be unavailable: documented source-conformant stochastic reruns are admissible with provenance, predeclared calibration tolerance and paired candidate-author evaluation on the same draws.

The candidate must surpass the source-paper balanced-accuracy result itself for the declared complete panel (reported 93%) at recovered source precision under a predeclared justified stochastic-calibration tolerance, as well as improve meaningfully over the calibrated author rerun with valid paired subject-level uncertainty. A weaker author rerun cannot lower the source target or make a candidate below the source result a paper win. Satisfy the panel's predeclared source controls and companion-metric requirements; merely reporting the candidate's relation to 93% is insufficient.

A different complete original Figure 5 panel can define a separately scoped comparison only when declared before candidate outcomes and retaining all its original participants, conditions, controls and metrics. Do not select an easier subject/window/state subset or favorable panel after seeing results; unrelated transition/transfer panels are not universal prerequisites.

Do not claim a win from stronger ISD state separation, smaller p-values, a Dataset-3/4/5-only classifier, pooled random windows or a changed nested/held-animal split protocol. Documented random redraws within the original protocol differ from these extensions.
Keep AUC, balanced accuracy and static ISD distinct and report source-paper, calibrated author-rerun and candidate scores separately.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

data_contract.neural: Participant-level regional BOLD time series, both with and without global-signal regression; publisher specifies dimensions and condition columns.

data_contract.time_alignment: Static state metric initially avoids unknown transition-event timing. Sliding-window transition claims require exact TR and responsiveness annotation audit.
